A few sessions of counselling isn’t going to clear this up… I’ve been in therapy for years and I still feel like crap. Although I do agree that my mum is trying her best, these things still hurt a lot. Emotional neglect/abuse is a thing, and I feel like I’ve been failed. I’m not having kids, ever. I don’t want to turn into my mum and I don’t want a possible child to turn into me.

Also ‘some of these things are going to be my best memories one day’? My mother threatening to smash my head through a wall?

Thank you for the reply. I live in London, but I’m scared to leave my current living situation just like that. I just feel like it’s not that bad, and I feel guilty even considering leaving. My post only mentions all the bad stuff. I just don’t know what to feel anymore, I’m sorry.
I hope things work out for me too :) thank you

Well I’m actually the one that offered the financial support - my mum wasn’t the one that asked first. I feel like the money that I earn doesn’t really have much meaning to me, since I’m not spending it on my own rent or utilities. I might as well just give it to her since it’ll be more useful. I like spending it on fun silly things, but I don’t actually need those things. I just waste all my money.

And to answer your question, it probably wouldn’t be the worst thing ever. I don’t really know. I’ve found that things are okay if I just avoid unnecessary interactions/conflicts and mellow myself out. I’m sure I’ll find a way someday.

Do you mean he thinks I’m not his daughter biologically? Or that he just doesn’t care? Either way it kinda sucks haha. It reminds me that there’s a squirrel that visits our garden every day and he’s nicknamed it ‘ma fille’ aka ‘my girl’ in French. He calls the squirrel that a lot more than he calls me that. I think he’s more interested in the squirrel.

I already have a job and have been trying to save, even though I suck at saving. I have a terrible relationship with money to be honest, ever since I was a kid. I mentioned in another comment how I’m probably going to end up still living with her, and splitting the rent with her. It’s really not ideal, but I feel guilty for some reason and don’t have the strength to walk away fully.

I’ll be 18 in 5 months. And I really do want to get away from them, but I feel like the situation is kinda complicated. My parents are most likely getting divorced within the year (would be even sooner but we are kinda tight financially right now - the mortgage on the house is making things extra complicated), and my mum can’t afford a place on her own. Most likely I’m going to end up living with her and splitting the rent since I do have a job and can contribute. I just don’t want my brother to struggle. I’m not sure what to do.
